prompt:
Game card item illustration of a long serpentine spirit dragon coiled in an S-shape: pale ivory-white scaled body shaded with cool blue-grey so it reads against white, small antler horns, flowing whiskers, and a long tail ending in wispy flame-like tufts, the whole body including every tail tuft outlined in dark ink. The attached reference images are STYLE references only: match their ink linework, flat posterized shading in two or three tonal steps and muted natural palette; do not copy their subjects or composition. A continuous dark ink outline around the whole subject, flat colour fills with a few tonal steps, small ink hatch marks for texture, muted naturalistic palette, light from the upper left, slight three-quarter angle, a single subject only, centred with a white margin on every side and never touching an edge, isolated on a solid flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) that fills every edge of the frame, no ground, no scenery, no cast shadow, no text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: watercolor, soft gradients, painterly texture, airbrush, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, glossy sheen, neon colors, multiple separate objects, cropped, blurry, grey background, off-white background, gradient background, checkerboard, transparency grid, scenery, ground plane, drop shadow, text, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, footprints, tracks, wings, fire breath, background clouds, a second dragon.
